title: SARSA and Q-learning on the cliff
brief: Write the two TD control updates, learn the cliff walk with each, and see them choose different paths from the same experience.
hints: SARSA's target uses the action you will actually take next: r + gamma * Q[s2, a2] * (not terminated). Q-learning's uses the max over actions, whatever you take: Q[s2].max().
Break ties with rng.choice(np.flatnonzero(q_row == q_row.max())). With Q = 0 everywhere, argmax always goes up into the wall.
In sarsa, choose the first action before the step loop, choose a2 before the update, and carry a2 into the next step as the action you take.
